links.outcome: Stereotyping or negative depictions of older adults and people with dementia in generated images
links.effect: Both models more often portrayed subjects with negative affect in response to dementia-related prompts than for control prompts. DALL-E 3 also generated more positive-affect personas. Chi-square tests showed significant disparities versus controls.
links.quote: Both models more often portrayed subjects in response to dementia-related prompts with negative affect, in less favorable emotional states.

unlisted_practices: Careful prompt selection to avoid negative depictions of dementia in AI-generated images

screen.reason: Empirical content analysis evaluating bias and stigmatization in images generated by text-to-image AI tools (DALL-E 3 and Midjourney) depicting aging and dementia.
